documents.title: COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30Th, 2026.
COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30Th, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Modis Navnirman Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, highlighting year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax. Management discussed their redevelopment-focused asset-light model in the Mumbai region, ongoing execution across current projects, and demand trends in the real estate market. The company also addressed project pipelines, inventory status, and the temporary impact of material cost pressures during the quarter. Modis Navnirman Limited reported a strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations increasing by 27.9% to ₹58.26 crore and PAT rising by 25.8% to ₹8.54 crore. Construction progressed steadily across key ongoing projects such as Rashmi Square, Rashmi Signature, Rashmi Delight, Rashmi Manorath, Rashmi Icon, and Rashmi Avenue.

EBITDA margin including other income was 19.83% in Q1 FY27.
